title: EX-01 — setup, inspect, replay and verify a scripted run
fixture_label: scripted-lane fixture: the deterministic EmbedModel port drives the run — no real model, provider, task efficacy or study evidence

prerequisites.companion: the verbatim committed-HEAD README quickstart leg is scripts/check-quickstart.sh's check — it is not re-run here

negative_controls: stale pin — a drifted card sha256 or edited definition refuses stale_pin before any execution
tampered copy — a mutated prefix event is not_admitted (recorded verbatim, never a pass)
exit zero is insufficient — the verdict is semantic; the card fails when a check fails

costs.build: one cargo build/test of hharness + deps (minutes, existing toolchain); no added dependencies
costs.runtime: seconds; two scratch stores (producer + clean recipient) + one exported bundle; no network, no provider, $0

limitations: fixture-only teaching — never satisfies S1/S3, useful-task, live or study readiness
the scripted lane's model calls are deterministic — excerpts prove trace resolution, not model behavior
verify leg is R0 lifecycle recompute + completeness; R1 rides the replay admission only
replay admission covers the exported record's prefix/markers/rederivation — not a fresh model drive
